verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training data policy, or any commitment about whether user content is used to train AI models. Self-hosting ('that place is yours') and the provider-agnostic agent runtime, including local Ollama, are adjacent data-residency features and user-side workarounds, not a documented training-prevention capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
